rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's nineteen builder trees go (ficus, five canary date palms in the back yards, corals 1.1-3 m from the house fronts, magnolias, jacarandas, a fan palm); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the arbor, the two adirondack chairs, and in two back yards 12-14 m from the houses.

trees.why: the back yard with the garden arbor (1.9 m off): a magnolia beside it
the east yard with the adirondack chair (1.5 m off): a jacaranda to sit under
the west yard's adirondack chair (2.2 m off): the same, 54 m on
